entries.decision: Do not retain this indivisible raw tuple as an active lookup alternative. Preserve its immutable canonical bytes as honest source history. Add separately authored reviewed noun senses for supported meanings instead.
entries.reason: The old tuple places 保单 alongside warranty. A product warranty or a condition/promise in an insurance contract is not an insurance policy. Retaining the complete tuple would teach an incorrect policy equivalence; silently trimming a third-party tuple would misrepresent its source. The valid formal/document and American authorization/justification senses are separately preserved in the new original numbered meanings.
entries.authoredMeaning:
① 质保；商品保修承诺。卖方或制造商按约定条件，对指定的商品问题提供维修、更换等处理的承诺。
②（合同等法律语境）保证或担保；对某项事实或条件作出的保证，也可指载明这种保证的书面文件（保证书）。
③（美式用法）授权；正当理由或根据。
